reason: 该插件的主要面向是 DeepSeek DSH Web 聊天界面的一种通用工具增强：在助手消息中选文后通过“引用”按钮生成可附着于待发送草稿的引用块，并结合发送节点清理状态，避免旧引用残留；证据来自仓库说明、功能清单与包声明的 Web 平台客户端注入配置，故归类为通用实用型聊天插件。

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH Web 对话的聊天工具插件，可选中助手回复并通过“引用”按钮生成引用块，在发送时随消息一并提交。
summaries.en: This is a DSH Web chat utility plugin that lets you select assistant replies and create quote blocks, then include them when sending a message.

capabilities: Captures selected text from assistant messages for quote annotation
Inserts generated quote blocks into the composer before sending
Provides explicit Quote-button workflow with optional empty-quote mode
Tracks and updates floating quote-count labels relative to multiline composer layout
Clears stale quote draft state on send-confirmation patterns to reduce ghost-quote carryover
